settings.label: Wrap long lines
settings.description: Wrap long lines at the window edge.

settings.label: Line numbers
settings.description: Show absolute line numbers.

settings.label: Relative numbers
settings.description: Show distances from the cursor line.

settings.label: Indent with spaces
settings.description: Insert spaces instead of a tab character.

settings.label: Tab width
settings.description: Visual width of a tab character.

settings.label: Indent width
settings.description: Width of one indentation step.

settings.label: Mouse modes
settings.description: Modes in which mouse input is enabled; empty disables it.

settings.label: Ignore search case
settings.description: Ignore letter case in searches.

settings.label: Smart search case
settings.description: Use exact case when the search contains uppercase letters.

settings.label: Scroll context
settings.description: Keep context lines above and below the cursor.

settings.label: Persistent undo
settings.description: Keep undo history between Neovim sessions.

settings.label: Confirm abandoning changes
settings.description: Ask before abandoning a modified buffer.

settings.label: Split to the right
settings.description: Open vertical splits to the right.

settings.label: Split below
settings.description: Open horizontal splits below.

settings.label: Colorscheme
settings.description: Color theme; plugin themes are downloaded and pinned, built-in themes need no download.

settings.label: Plugin manager
settings.description: Choose before enabling plugin-backed features.

settings.label: Fuzzy finder
settings.description: Native commands have no dependencies; Snacks offers broad sources; mini.pick is compact.

settings.label: File explorer
settings.description: Native directories, Oil editable directories, or a Snacks sidebar with search and file operations.

settings.label: Git hunks
settings.description: Native diff or inline Git changes with Gitsigns.

settings.label: LSP configurations
settings.description: Generated native configurations or nvim-lspconfig definitions.

settings.label: TypeScript / JavaScript LSP
settings.description: Use ts_ls; skip Deno projects.

settings.label: Lua LSP
settings.description: Use lua_ls with Neovim runtime awareness.

settings.label: HTML LSP
settings.description: Use the VS Code HTML language server.

settings.label: CSS LSP
settings.description: Use the VS Code CSS language server.

settings.label: JSON LSP
settings.description: Use the VS Code JSON language server.

settings.label: Native LSP completion
settings.description: Automatic native LSP completion; Enter is not remapped.

settings.label: Diagnostic text
settings.description: Show diagnostic messages beside code.

settings.label: Formatting owner
settings.description: One formatting owner: native LSP or Conform with Prettier and StyLua.

settings.label: Format on save
settings.description: Format selected filetypes on save; off unless explicitly selected.

settings.label: Tool acquisition
settings.description: Use existing PATH programs or explicitly reviewed Mason installations.

settings.label: Statusline
settings.description: Mode, Git branch, diagnostics, active language servers and cursor position.

settings.label: Buffer tabs
settings.description: Visible open buffers with diagnostic counts; Shift-H / Shift-L switch files.

settings.label: Shortcut guidance
settings.description: Press Space and pause to see available commands grouped by task.

settings.label: Workspace layout
settings.description: Rich adds a welcome screen, sidebar, floating input and terminal, indentation guides and consistent shortcuts.

settings.label: Custom theme repository
settings.description: GitHub repository of a theme ShoshinVim does not list, as owner/name.

settings.label: Custom theme revision
settings.description: The exact commit of the custom theme that was reviewed and will be downloaded.

settings.label: Custom theme colorscheme
settings.description: The :colorscheme name the custom theme provides.

settings.label: Completion engine
settings.description: Which engine shows completion suggestions.
